nodes.question: What shift is occurring among green economy and sustainable consumption advocates in high-income countries?
nodes.answer: Advocates are shifting their focus towards understanding the global environmental impacts of national economic activity rather than solely focusing on local consumption to address the rising extraterritorial environmental impacts.
